name: lost_woods
label: Lost Woods
about: Pieces and textures cut from Lost Woods (spot10). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09). `ground` is every clearing's floor (a plain camo, no detail texture), `forest_wall` the dark hedge walls round each clearing (a grass lip at the foot), `log_bark`, `tunnel_ring` and `tunnel_dark` the log tunnels and their fading interiors. `stump_bark` and `stump_top` are the vertex-shaded stumps, `hedge_top` and `grass_skirt` the tall grass, `stone_pillar`, `stone_floor` and `stone_wall` the stone-lined passages (Goron City, Zora's River), `bridge_log` and `bridge_rope` the bridge to Kokiri Forest; `light_shaft` and `light_pool` are the translucent sunbeams.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: lw_log_tunnel
pieces.label: Log tunnel (exit)
pieces.about: A hollow log through the hedge wall, fading to black: the clearings' dead ends (exit 1 sent Link back to Kokiri Forest). The origin is on the wall's face at the tunnel's floor, facing out; it runs 600 into the wall (y scale shortens it), the exit floor starting 200 in.

pieces.name: lw_goron_passage
pieces.label: Stone passage (exit)
pieces.about: The stone-framed doorway and its corridor sloping down (80) into the dark: the shortcut to Goron City (exit 7, ENTR_SPOT18_3), set in the north wall of its clearing. The origin is the doorway's foot on the wall's face; the exit floor starts 220 in. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: lw_underwater_passage
pieces.label: Underwater passage (exit)
pieces.about: A stone-framed swim tunnel 60 high at the bottom of the pond: the shortcut to Zora's River (exit 8, ENTR_SPOT03_4). Its frame rises 285 to stand clear of the water. The origin is the tunnel's foot on the pool wall's face. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: lw_bridge
pieces.label: Log bridge
pieces.about: Logs lashed side by side, with rope rails: the bridge over the gully between Kokiri Forest and the way to Hyrule Field. 400 long and 210 wide; the origin is the deck's middle. Its length scales.

pieces.name: lw_stump_roots
pieces.label: Stump with roots
pieces.about: A low stump (40) with its roots spread, on the Skull Kids' stage in the sunken clearing. Shaded by vertex colours; Link can stand on it.

pieces.name: lw_stump_double
pieces.label: Double stump
pieces.about: Two stumps grown together, 86 and 108 tall, on the Skull Kids' stage.

pieces.name: lw_stump_tall
pieces.label: Tall stump
pieces.about: A narrow stump 80 tall, where the Skull Kid sits by the forest's entrance.

pieces.name: lw_stump_low
pieces.label: Low stump
pieces.about: A wide stump 20 tall, the Skull Kid's step.

pieces.name: lw_post
pieces.label: Log post
pieces.about: A tall log post (410) standing in the gully under the bridge to Kokiri Forest.

pieces.name: lw_post_stepped
pieces.label: Log post, stepped top
pieces.about: A log post 350 tall from the gully under the bridge.

pieces.name: lw_ladder
pieces.label: Ladder
pieces.about: A wooden ladder 195 tall up the side of the sunken clearing (wall types ladder and ladder_top). Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: lw_ladder_tall
pieces.label: Tall ladder
pieces.about: A wooden ladder 375 tall from the gully under the bridge up to the forest floor. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: lw_tall_grass
pieces.label: Tall grass
pieces.about: A patch of tall grass 28 tall that Link wades through, from the sunken clearing.

pieces.name: lw_light_beam
pieces.label: Sunbeam
pieces.about: A translucent shaft of light 800 tall falling through the canopy onto the Skull Kid's stump. No collision.
